train_loss: binary cross-entropy on actual query labels, using the model output API correctly

sgcc.threshold_selection: validation F1 for secondary F1/recall only

test_access: only after final checkpoint selection; no tuning on test outcomes
data_order: one shuffled pass through all training rows; every row is a query exactly once; keep final partial batch
checkpoint_selection: maximize fixed validation primary metric between initial and one-epoch checkpoint; ties retain initial weights; no hyperparameter search
validation_schedule: before training and after the complete single epoch
context_scope: 1024 applies to training episodes; fixed validation/test contexts stay identical to direct inference
